course_name_original: Einführung in das wissenschaftliche Arbeiten in der Mechatronik
course_name_en: Introduction to Scientific Work in Mechatronics
prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: understand a specific research topic in the field of electrical engineering;
are able to grasp, classify and evaluate the state of the art on a given research question;
are able to research and evaluate scientific-technical literature;
are able to present scientific topics in written and oral form.

syllabus_topics: Autonomous acquisition, classification, and evaluation of the state of the art of a research topic
Familiarization and understanding of the topic area
Classification of the topic area within the scientific spectrum
Adherence to the rules of good scientific practice
Written and oral presentation of results
